My Family Tree is genealogy software made by Chronoplex Software.
Features
My Family Tree has a simple and intuitive interface.
You can view your tree in four fully interactive charts.
Enhance your tree with charts, reports, photos, and more.
View family history timelines, statistics, relationships, and interactive maps.
Record citations and evidence for the information in your family tree.
Comprehensive GEDCOM support (version 1.0 through 7.0, including GEDZIP).
Record and display dates in over 25 different calendars.
MFT version history
1.0.0.0  was released 2011-03-02.
2.0.0.0  was released 2012-04-28.
Better support for GEDCOM files and improved printing functionality with print preview.
3.0.0.0  was released 2013-06-01.
Support for relationship events, multiple names, citations, addresses, and contact details.
4.0.0.0  was released 2014-10-05.
By marriage (in law) and step relationships have been added to the relationship calculator.
5.0.0.0  was released 2015-11-10.
Merge has been redesigned to allow you to confirm or reject possible item matches.
6.0.0.0  was released 2016-08-20.
You can now enter dates in one of 6 calendars (Gregorian, Julian, Hebrew, French Republican, Persian (solar Hijri) and Islamic (lunar Hijri).
7.0.0.0  was released 2017-04-15.
Direct import for Personal Ancestral File files and importing older GEDCOM 1.0 files.
8.0.0.0  was released 2018-05-07.
Improvements in calendars and translations.
9.0.0.0  was released 2019-10-27.
Improvements in date validation and new chart options.
10.0.0.0  was released 2020-04-16.
New chart types and chart colours, family chart lines and chart dates. New ways to build a tree, new report types, duplicate person replace / merge tool and support for additional types of marriage and relationships.
11.0.0.0  was released 2021-06-07.
Full support for GEDCOM 7.0
14.0.0.0  was released 2023-11-14.
Changes in chart colour modes and filters.
15.0.0.0  was released 2025-03-16.
Changes in finding family tree files and identifiers (IDs).
Languages
My Family Tree is available in over 30 languages spanning every continent in the world with help from over 60 users. New features may not be translated from the beginning.
Requirements
Requires the Microsoft .NET Desktop Runtime 9.0 or later.
